William Jefferson  Clinton (né Blythe III; born August 19, 1946) is an American retired politician and lawyer  who served as the 42nd president of the United States from 1993 to 2001. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served as the attorney general of Arkansas from 1977 to 1979, the governor of Arkansas from 1979 to 1981, and governor again from 1983 to 1992.

What Bill Clinton wanted at the start and what Bill Clinton got are not the same thing, and that gap is the story. After Oxford, Clinton attended Yale Law School and earned a Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree in 1973. In 1971, he met his future wife, Hillary Rodham, in the Yale Law Library; she was a class year ahead of him.
